nodes.question: What is the significance of using digital nudges to alter environmental-friendly behaviour in an online setting?
nodes.answer: The impact of digital nudges in altering environmental-friendly behaviour online can help clarify their influence, especially since most studies on nudges are usually performed in an offline setting.
